issue.title: Stream Muse commentary into the live Reply card
issue.description: While a Muse agent runs, each commentary message Muse commits to its session log appears in live_reply.md, and so in the main deck's Reply card, within about a second. The returned reply, token usage, final-answer streaming, and host finalizers are unchanged, and tests exercise the real Muse 1.4.13 stream shape so this gap cannot hide again.
